finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: A filename that contains shell metacharacters like ';' or '|'
finding.assumptions: The system where this code runs allows shell interpretation of filenames, which is common in some environments.

parsed.refutation_attempt: The sink is an ifstream constructor (line 3), which internally calls the OS file‑open API with the supplied filename. It does not invoke a shell, system() or similar functions that would interpret metacharacters. Therefore the filename is not treated as a command, and OS command injection cannot occur from this code fragment.
